Chapter 6468: One Move

Chapter 6468: One Move

“How do you want to die?” Li Qiye said casually before yawning.

He sounded as if he was talking to a friend, yet everyone felt a chill and saw themselves falling into an abyss. Some touched their neck, hoping their head would still be on top.

This feeling was so strange and dreadful - an ordinary youth without any power turned out to be a true monster.

Rising and Earthsplitter stared at Li Qiye intensely while shivering. Upon closer inspection, they found this ordinary man to be one with heaven and earth, not just the dream world.

Alch-deer was one with Gold Village but Li Qiye gave a different impression. Where he stood was heaven and earth.

Rising and Earthsplitter suddenly thought of one word - creator. From that, the next logical thought became the image of the high heaven.

Of course, they knew little about this illusory concept. No one could give them an answer either.

They were confident against Alch-deer, knowing they wouldn’t die easily. The same couldn’t be said about this youth.

“Amitabha, I would like to try a few moves, Sir.” Rising took a deep breath.

“Try? And a few moves? I wonder if you think too highly of yourself or too little of me. I only need one move to kill you two.” Li Qiye said.

“What?!” The crowd was astounded.

“One move?” Rising and Earthsplitter couldn’t believe it.

“What type of technique will it be?” Rising asked, unable to imagine something capable of destroying two primal anima.

“Just a random one. Are you ready?” Li Qiye smiled.

Earthsplitter turned red, never having been so humiliated before. She preferred death over dishonor.

“Fine, let’s see it.” She said.

“Yes.” Rising was a primal ancestor before a monk, feeling the same rage.

“Phoenix Extinguishment!” Earthsplitter burned her vitality and used the golden tree to the fullest.

She was ready to die but wanted to bring Li Qiye down with her. The halberd glowed red due to the infusion of her true blood.

Rising tapped the wooden fish again before changing: “Destruction!”

A Buddhist fruit manifested into reality. In the next second, cracks appeared on it and Buddhist power oozed out.

“Rumble!” Gold Village couldn’t contain their power since they resorted to burning their true blood.

This wasn’t a fight to survive. They wanted to bring him down with them and unleashed a firepower far beyond what they mustered against Alch-deer.

“This is it?” Li Qiye glanced at it before extending one hand forward.

He then swung it as though he were swatting a mosquito.

“Bang!” The world-ending attacks seemed as fragile as dough and crumbled upon contact.
